title: What The Wind Knows — EN/ES/FR (Chas McIvor)
style: jazz lounge piano bar dry wit spoken word observational 102bpm upright bass brushed snare deadpan baritone male vocal life philosophy Spanish French language learning Perth Zimbabwe wind
lyrics:
[Verse 1 — English]
The wind is the oldest thing still moving — it predates the ground
It was there before the first thing that it moved around
The wind has been to every place and left its record there
In the angle of the trees and in the texture of the air

[Verse 2 — Spanish, with English translation]
El viento es lo más antiguo que aún se mueve — precede al suelo
[The wind is the oldest thing still moving — it predates the ground]
Estaba allí antes de la primera cosa que movió en su vuelo
[It was there before the first thing it moved in its flight]
El viento ha estado en todos los lugares y ha dejado su huella
[The wind has been to every place and left its mark]
En el ángulo de los árboles y en la textura de la centella
[In the angle of the trees and in the texture of the spark]

[Chorus — English]
What does the wind know that I don't know?
It knows every coastline and every corridor below
What does the wind know from three thousand metres?
It knows the temperature of every continent and its features
That's my boy

[Bridge — French, with English translation]
Le vent est la chose la plus ancienne encore en mouvement
[The wind is the oldest thing still moving]
Il était là avant la première chose qu'il a déplacée lentement
[It was there before the first thing it moved slowly]
Le vent a été dans tous les endroits et y a laissé son empreinte
[The wind has been to every place and left its mark there]
Dans l'angle des arbres et dans la texture de l'étreinte
[In the angle of the trees and in the texture of the embrace]

[Outro — All three languages]
What the wind knows… Lo que sabe el viento… Ce que sait le vent
Every place it has ever been — Cada lugar que ha visitado — Chaque endroit où il est allé
That's my boy
